\chapter{Implementation and Performance}

\section{Concurrency Model}
The system architecture separates compute-intensive operations from asynchronous I/O and user interaction:
\begin{itemize}
  \item \textbf{Rayon Thread Pool:} Dedicated to CPU-heavy document parsing, font rendering, and AST evaluation.
  \item \textbf{Tokio Runtime:} Handles asynchronous file events, network requests, and external process management.
  \item \textbf{Main UI Thread:} Dispatches presentation state and maintains 60/120 FPS rendering without blocking.
\end{itemize}

\section{Benchmark Analysis}
Numerical benchmarks demonstrate consistent sub-50 ms recompile latencies across documents up to 50 pages, exceeding initial performance budgets.
